_comments.randomIdPrefixGeneration: Adds a unique random prefix to generated component IDs {Default setting is true}.
_comments.autoGenerateIDsForLayouts: Generates IDs only for layout components (Panel, Columns, Container, etc.{Default setting is false}).
_comments.listOutDuplicateIds: Logs duplicate component IDs before save. {Default setting is false}
_comments.autoGenerateIds: Modify Duplicate ids button will showup but 1st we need to enable listOutDuplicateIds. { Default setting is false}
_comments.flattenSubmissionData: Modifies the submission data to be flat instead of nested. {Default setting is false}.
